note_reset: D50 puts `upgrades` on this side of the line deliberately. The full upgrade tree is allowed BECAUSE the season bounds it: a veteran's advantage expires with the world instead of compounding across seasons, so craft persists (recognition) and power does not. The key is listed before upgrades exist so the rule is recorded where the tuning lives, not only in a spec.
note_dayNight: D63a. The LIGHT cycle is compressed game time, separate from the calendar day (TICKS_PER_DAY) the seasons count: a deployment must SEE both phases or 'wait for dark' can never be a decision. The sizing originally cited D11's 40-60 min deployment band, which D69d RETIRED; it now rests on measurement instead. Era-3 (n=300): median deployment 12.4 min for the AI, 24.8-49.6 min human-adjusted - so a human deployment spans the 30 min cycle and does see both, which is what this number has to guarantee. NOTE the short end: an 18 min day phase against a 24.8 min deployment means a player dropping at dawn waits most of their sortie for dark. Whether that is tension or dead time is a playtest question, not a measured one. 30 min full cycle: 18 day / 12 night. nightSightPct is the ruled 30%: at night, WATCHERS (patrol sight, camera range) see at 70% — the agent's own senses are untouched, night helps the sneak without blinding the player.
